title: One round of judging: the attempt, the commit judged, the profile seated, every seat's vote as cast, and the round's vote

attempt.description: The attempt whose commit the round judged, by its path in the ledger.

commit.description: The commit judged: the goal branch's tip as read back from the remote after the push, never a hash an agent reported.

profile.description: The panel profile seated, by its name in the limits.

seats.description: Every seat as the kernel seated it, with its vote as cast.

passed.description: The round's vote: true only when every seat passed or is vouched.

vote.description: What the seat returned: pass, fail with findings, or inconclusive with a cause.

confidence.description: The seat's confidence in its vote, from 0 to 1, as it gave it.

findings.description: The seat's findings as it gave them; empty when it found nothing.

cause.description: Why the seat was inconclusive, as it gave it; required exactly when its vote is inconclusive.

detail.description: The finding as the seat wrote it: data the ledger never interprets.

remediation.description: What the seat says would resolve it, as the seat wrote it.
